scoring_method: Arithmetic mean of the six category scores, rounded to one decimal place.

r8_alignment_assessment.assessment: Fixes prior interior vertical disconnect and creates a continuous modeled library-to-core route. Plan supports zone/core relationship but not absolute elevations or corridor width; geometry remains schematic.

footprint_assessment.limitation: Bounding-box agreement is not full polygon agreement; structural centerline distances include expected wall-thickness offset and are not surveyed tolerances.

technical_checks.limitations: Sample geometry and reopen checks do not validate complete facade accuracy, real window schedule, metric elevation, roof form, or as-built interior.

major_remaining_issues: No measured elevation supports the modeled 33.2 m shell height, 42.9 m total extent, floor spacing, roof/penthouse, or mast.
Large blank facade wings and north/west elevation details are not source-verified.
Overview brick color/material appears flatter and paler than the limited exterior reference.
Interior circulation now aligns internally, but room/furniture arrangement and connector dimensions remain schematic; R8 oblique is difficult to assess at overview scale.
